futureFullSourcePin: Root supplies the scripts-only pin after import; preparation pin is provenance only.
captureAssignment: Root runs the separately reviewed external generator with concrete fresh parameters, then separately assigns the resulting exact capture digest.
auditAssignment: Root later creates a fresh phase-audit assignment and a separate wrapper digest; capture authority and native audit digest do not authorize it.
protectedProcess: Root supplies the unchanged five-key PID1063/start874/exe/cwd/argv descriptor and socket list. Protected full argv equality remains strict.
ownedProcess: Wrapper keeps five-key child-facing descriptor snapshots. Internal PID/start/session/executable/cwd plus bound PIDFD determine owned liveness and signaling; changed raw NUL cmdline observations are separate events.
sourceBindingSchemas: Capture uses feature63-new-source-binding-v1 with numeric mode. Closed-native audit uses feature63-source-binding-v1 with gitMode/gitBlob; root must not reuse capture source binding unchanged.
nativeLifetime: unobservedDescendantsExcluded=false and rootNativeLifetimeDispositionRequired=true remain. Root admission later requires ownedNativeLifetimeIndependentlyAdmitted=true.
candidateSealOrder: Seal current packet after candidate review; generator and final filled-generator review remain outside seal to avoid hash cycles.
